concerns.text: T104 requires the convergence monitor to flag iterations with 'tolerance < 1e-4', but the convergence-log record schema T101 writes is '[{"iteration_id", "sample_size", "converged", "max_iterations", "error_message"}]' — no tolerance field is ever produced. The monitor's acceptance criterion reads a field that cannot exist, so the SC-004-adjacent deliverable is unverifiable as specified. Either add a tolerance field to T101's log schema or drop the tolerance criterion from T104.

T103 asserts 'data/aggregated/split_half_results.json ... contains a binary replication status', but T102 defines that file's schema as aggregated per-sample-size records '[{"sample_size", "kernel", "replication_rate", "iterations"}]' — a float rate, not a binary status. T103's verification condition cannot be checked against the artifact T102 actually produces; align the assertion with the T102 schema (e.g., assert replication_rate ∈ [0,1] and iterations ≥ 1) or have T102 also emit per-iteration binary records.

All 'verified completed work' items V01–V09 are rendered as unchecked boxes '- [ ]' despite the header stating they are 'verified complete' and 'preserve; do not redo'. An implementer or execution agent parsing checkbox state will redo preserved work. Mark them '- [x]' or restructure as a non-checklist block.
